xp.note: XP measures engagement only. It never unlocks grades, never counts as mastery and never appears in readiness estimates. Each award has a unique source-event key; replays earn XP at most twice per node per day.

mastery.note: Thresholds are placeholders for Brief 04 to tune empirically and confirm with a teacher. Accessible alternative interactions carry the same evidence weight.

review.note: Per-concept spaced review. A wrong review answer triggers a worked explanation and a short remedial step before rescheduling.

unlocking.lesson: A node unlocks when every node in its unlockAfter list is complete (default: the previous required lesson, practice or review node). Unlocked nodes can always be replayed.
unlocking.unit: The first lesson of a unit unlocks after the previous unit's review node. Unit challenges are mastery evidence and do not gate the next unit.
unlocking.grade: A grade world unlocks when the previous grade's teaching path is complete, or through placement (Brief 10). Learners may always start lower without penalty.
unlocking.gradeCompletion: An in-app grade badge requires passing the grade assessment, which independently samples every outcome introduced at that grade. XP and lesson completion never award it.

readiness.note: Configurable in-app readiness default. It is not presented as an official ABRSM pass mark.
